title: EOCR-SS2 - Samwha electronic overload relay, definite time, 2CT (legacy model)
range_short_desc: Legacy 2CT electronic overload relay with definite time characteristic
description: LEGACY MODEL — still supplied by SAV. Samwha EOCR-SS2 electronic overload relay in the original Samwha Engineering housing, from before the EOCR line came under Schneider Electric. Two integral current transformers, definite time characteristic, and independently adjustable starting trip delay (D-TIME) and trip time (O-TIME), so a motor can be given a long start window without dulling the running trip. Protects against over-current, phase loss and locked rotor, with two LEDs on the dial plate giving run-monitor and trip-cause indication. 35 mm DIN rail mounting. The unit SAV stocks is Type 60-440: 5–60/70 A current range on 320–480 VAC control power.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Two integral current transformers — no external CT needed within the rated range
Independently adjustable starting trip delay (D-TIME) and trip time (O-TIME)
Definite time characteristic (the inverse-time sibling is the EOCR-SS1)
Run monitor and troubleshooting from two LEDs on the dial plate
TEST and RESET buttons on the front face

feature_groups.title: Legacy status
items: Original Samwha Engineering Co., Ltd. product, made in Seoul, Korea — predates the Schneider Electric EOCR branding
SAV continues to stock it for like-for-like replacement in panels already built around it

specs.group: Nameplate of the stocked unit (photographed from SAV stock)
rows: Model : EOCR-SS2
Current range : 5 ~ 60/70 A
Power supply : 320~480 VAC
Maker : 삼화기연주식회사 SAMWHA Engineering Co., Ltd. — Made in Seoul, Korea
Marks : CE, recyclable
Front panel : MON. (green) and TRIP (red) LEDs, D-TIME 1–50 sec, LOAD (A) 5–70, O-TIME 1–10 sec, TEST and RESET
Protective items : over-current, phase loss, locked rotor
Over-current trip time : O-TIME
Phase loss trip time : O-TIME
Locked rotor trip time : O-TIME + D-TIME
Time characteristic : definite — shares the definite-time curve of the EOCR-SP2 / SS2 / DS2(T) / DS3(T)
Protection ranges : 0.5–6 A, 3–30 A, 5–60 A, plus an external CT option above 60 A
D-TIME (starting trip delay) : 1–50 sec
O-TIME (trip time) : 0.2–10 sec
Output contact, X1 mode : 1-SPST, 3 A / 250 VAC resistive, normally energised
Output contact, X2 mode : 1-SPDT, 3 A / 250 VAC resistive, normally de-energised
Indication : 2-LED, trip and trip-cause
Mounting : 35 mm DIN rail
Current transformers : 2CT, integral

specs.group: LED display table (printed on the unit)
rows: Columns : green LED (MON.) and red LED (TRIP), each shown as on / off / flicker
Conditions listed : Stop, Run, Starting, Overloading, O.C Trip, Locked Trip, Phase Loss Trip
Phase loss trip additionally indicates the affected phase R, S or T
Current setting codes : 05 (0.5–6 A), 30 (3–30 A), 60 (5–60 A), 100~ (over 60 A, external CT)
Control voltage codes : 24 (24 VAC/DC, 50/60 Hz), 110, 220 — per the EOCR-SS1 / SS2 page of SAV's catalog edition

The stocked unit is Type 60-440, i.e. the 60 current code on a 440 V class control supply (320~480 VAC). That 440 code is not printed on the SS1/SS2 page of this catalog edition, though the neighbouring EOCR-SS / AR pages do list a 320–480 VAC option — so treat 440 as a later addition and confirm the control voltage from the unit's own label before quoting
